entries.text: Worked on the Little Dart Mk 26 (version 13, 96% built): installed high-grade copper wire Rusty Jr. into the primary console harness to link the navigation display (used Bix, a scorched heat tile)
welding fine copper wiring into the cockpit dash of the Little Dart
entries.why: i want the Little Dart Mk 26 to have the finest control panel in the whole sector
entries.detail: installed high-grade copper wire Rusty Jr. into the primary console harness to link the navigation display

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Wiring the HUD!"
Woke up with the first sun, fully charged.
Added to who he is (quirk): taps a merry metallic rhythm when the cantina band plays my favourite song
plugged into the charging dock to sleep
entries.why: my battery meter is dipping down and it is time for a proper recharge.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Time to recharge!"
tapping a rhythmic metallic beat along with the cantina brass band
entries.why: That brass horn section is too good to leave just yet.
